item.title: Democrat Vitale wins special election for Fairfield first selectman
item.description: FAIRFIELD, Conn. (WTNH) — In a closely-watched special election to be first selectman of Fairfield, Christine Vitale, a Democrat, defeated Tony Hwang, a Republican who represents the town and three surrounding communities in the State Senate. item.title: Homeschool reforms a priority for leading Connecticut legislator
item.description: On the eve before the start of the 2026 session of the Connecticut state legislature, the influential Democratic president of the State Senate told News 8 that his caucus, which holds a supermajority in the legislature's upper chamber, will push for increased regulations on homeschooling in Connecticut.

item.title: Connecticut's 2026 legislative session starts Feb. 4: What you need to know
item.description: Connecticut state legislators will reconvene on Wednesday for the annual legislative session. The agenda for the 13-week session will likely feature debates on topics ranging from immigration enforcement to the regulation of social media — all of it playing out against the backdrop of a gubernatorial election.
